description: A 3HP blank strip that carries a line of your own text down its face, for naming a group of modules; it has no jacks and passes no signal
notes: the strip does nothing until you right-click it and type into the text field in its menu; until then it reads Rt-click to edit
the text is written in white, sideways, and reading upwards from the bottom of the panel; long text breaks onto a second line on its own
the text is saved in the patch, and shows as Your message here! in the module browser
menu: Edit this strip's label: — the heading over a text field; type the strip's text there and press Enter, which sets it and closes the menu
Flip text top-to-bottom — turns the text the other way up so it reads downwards from the top of the panel
